description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class models an emergency contact entity for an employee, providing serialization and normalization features related to emergency contact details such as name, relationship, and phone numbers. It utilizes traits and interfaces to facilitate API responses and data handling.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee emergency contact information, implementing normalization and utilizing traits for common functionality.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmpEmergencyContact entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
